rule:
Arm B's four fields for every candidate of every review, and the checks made on the way.

`operating_margin_change_pts` comes from the logged sheet (the live code subtracts the same rounded margins).
`debt_growth_pct` comes from `SecFundamentals` over the cached SEC facts as of the review's `current_datetime`
(filings before the review day), used only when that re-read gives the logged sheet's two debt figures exactly;
otherwise from the sheet's rounded figures (their ratio), and counted. `days_since_filed` and
`return_since_filed_pct` come from `since_filing` over Yahoo's adjusted closes of the last 300 sessions strictly
before the review day, as the pipeline's daily series (`market_data.HISTORY_BARS`).
